API_CHANGE_REQUEST_APPROVED: Plan change approved. The workspace subscription and period credits are now up to date.
API_CHANGE_REQUEST_SUBMITTED: Plan change request submitted for platform review.
CREDITS_BUTTON_LABEL: {{count}} AI credits available. View plans and usage.
CREDITS_NO_AUTOMATIC_REFRESH: Credits do not refresh automatically on this plan
LEDGER_AI_COMMIT: Actual AI request credit usage settled.
LEDGER_AI_EXPIRATION: The AI request credit reservation expired and was released.
LEDGER_AI_RELEASE: The AI request credit reservation was released.
LEDGER_AI_RESERVATION: Credits reserved for the AI request.
LEDGER_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Review grants, reservations, settlements, releases, expirations, and operator adjustments for this workspace. Ledger records are immutable.
LEDGER_PERIOD_EXPIRATION: Unused credits from the previous period expired.
LEDGER_PERIOD_GRANT: Credits granted for the new period.
OPERATOR_MANAGED_DESCRIPTION: Your request is reviewed by a platform operator before the plan changes. Arclayer will not show an upgrade as complete until it is approved.
PLAN_DEFAULT_FREE_DESCRIPTION: For exploring core capabilities and lightweight project collaboration.
PLAN_DEFAULT_PREMIUM_DESCRIPTION: For sustained production and high-volume AI collaboration.
PLAN_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: Compare active workspace plans and request the option that matches your AI workload and operating needs.
PLAN_PENDING_DESCRIPTION: A request for the {{plan}} plan is waiting for platform review.
PLAN_REQUEST_SUCCESS: Plan request submitted for platform review.
SETTINGS_CATALOG_DESCRIPTION: Plans are workspace-scoped. Changes to credit value affect future charges only; ledger history remains immutable.
SETTINGS_CREDIT_VALUE_DESC: Provider cost represented by one credit. Historical ledger entries keep the value applied at charge time.
SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Configure the plan catalog, AI Credits economics, availability, and operator-managed upgrade workflow.
SETTINGS_EMPTY_DESC: Create an active plan before workspaces can compare commercial options.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_DESCRIPTION: Define the plan economics and entitlements exposed to workspace owners. All prices are stored as integer microdollars.
SETTINGS_FEATURE_INCLUDED_LABEL: Include this feature in the plan
SETTINGS_FEATURES_EMPTY: No feature entitlements have been added to this plan.
SETTINGS_PLAN_CODE_DESC: Lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens. The code cannot change after creation.
SETTINGS_REQUEST_APPROVED: Plan change approved. The workspace plan and period credits are now up to date.
SETTINGS_REQUEST_REJECT_DESCRIPTION: Reject the workspace request for the {{plan}} plan. The current subscription and credits remain unchanged, and the review reason is retained with the request.
SETTINGS_REQUEST_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Review the workspace request for the {{plan}} plan. Approval immediately switches the subscription and grants credits for the new period.
SETTINGS_REQUEST_REVIEW_NOTE_OPTIONAL: Optional. This note is retained with the plan-change record.
SETTINGS_REQUEST_REVIEW_NOTE_REQUIRED: Explain why the request is rejected so the workspace owner can take the next action.
SETTINGS_REQUESTS_DESCRIPTION: Review workspace plan changes in one queue. Approval atomically updates the subscription, credit account, ledger, and audit trail.
SETTINGS_REQUESTS_EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: There are no plan change requests matching the current filter.
SETTINGS_VALIDATION_CODE: Use 2–48 lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter.
SETTINGS_VALIDATION_CURRENCY: Enter a three-letter ISO currency code, such as USD or CNY.
SETTINGS_VALIDATION_NON_NEGATIVE: Enter zero or a positive value.
SETTINGS_VALIDATION_POSITIVE: Enter a value greater than zero.
